FIELD NOTE NO. 04
The Black Barn returns to the spring calendar.

After a quiet winter — new flooring, a re-pointed chimney, and a set of brass sconces from a Hudson workshop — the Black Barn at Kerhonkson reopens its doors on April the third. We have held a handful of weekends back for repeat guests, and the rest are now open for booking through the studio.

REOPENS
Wednesday, 3 April
BEDROOMS
Three, plus a reading loft
CARETAKER
Imogen Devereaux
LEAD TIME
14-day forward window
FIELD NOTE NO. 05
Casa Encinal, between fog and fire.

Of all the houses in the portfolio, Casa Encinal is the one we most often photograph at four in the afternoon — that is when the Pacific fog reaches the deck and the room becomes a lantern. The caretaker lights the fire by quarter-past, without being asked. The kitchen is stocked with bread from the bakery in Big Sur Village.

Big Sur, California
